text: Advocate for Medicaid Expansion Take Action: Your legislators need to hear from you! Step 1: Find your legislative district and familiarize yourself with your representatives in the Idaho House and Idaho Senate. Find your legislative district here: https://legislature.idaho.gov/legislators/whosmylegislator/ Step 2: Plan your talking points. Be friendly but clear in what you are communicating. We want to convey gratefulness (“Thank you for fulfilling the will of the people…”); helpfulness (“I want to help anyway I can to see this implemented, so please don’t hesitate to call on me…”) and personalization (“I’m a working member of the gap population and I can’t tell you how much of a difference this will make in my family’s life…”). Our goal is to have legislators hear from their constituents. They need to know a clear and easy path is available to fully fund and implement Medicaid Expansion, exactly as it was written. Step 3: Make the calls! Write letters/email! Send in postcards! Our message: We urge them to support the will of the voters Prop 2 won with 60.6% of the vote It won in every region of Idaho Received majority support in 35 of 44 counties and 29 of 35 legislative districts. If you live in one of the 29 districts where Medicaid Expansion received more than 50% of the vote, emphasize your districts percentage. District numbers found here in Legislator Contact pdf. 	 	We endorse quick and proper funding Costs for Medicaid Expansion will see 90% of funds coming from Federal funds. The role of the legislature is to allocate the remaining 10%. The Governor-elect and the chairman of the House Health and Welfare committee have expressed that the necessary amount of funding for Medicaid Expansion is small and easy to allocate. Possible locations for funding include savings to the Catastrophic Health Care Fund, the Millennium Fund, and the General Fund. We oppose any changes to the law as written Proposing new Medicaid regulations will threaten access to care and increase costs. We have seen in other states that barriers to coverage come with increased administrative costs. These additional costs are not what Idahoans voted for. Any new regulations will create more red tape and government bureaucracy. This will lead to qualified Idahoans losing coverage due to burdensome paperwork and unnecessary deadlines. Instead of pursuing additional restrictions, we should focus on increasing health care coverage. Words to Use Will of the people Responsible solution Lessens taxpayer burdens Duty and responsibility Barriers to coverage Words to Avoid “Smart thing to do” Compassion “Saving people in the gap” Work requirements Sample script: To be used as inspiration. Please personalize your message when contacting your legislator by briefly stating the impact Prop 2 will have for you, your family and community once its implemented. Hi Rep. _____,My name is _____ I am a(n) (occupation) and I live in (town). I want to congratulate you on your recent win and I am looking forward to having you as my representative. I am calling/writing to urge you to execute on your responsibility to voters by implementing Proposition 2, Medicaid Expansion, exactly as is. In our district Prop 2 won with __% of the vote. The people have spoken and we are resoundingly in favor of our new law. I would also like to express my endorsement of quick and proper funding that will be addressed in the upcoming Legislative session. I was happy to hear that the Governor-elect and chairman of the House Health and Welfare committee have expressed that the necessary amount of funding Idaho is responsible for is small and easy to allocate. Pursuing quick and proper funding is the fiscally responsible solution that lessens taxpayer burden. I would also like to express my opposition to any changes to the law as written. Proposing new Medicaid regulations will threaten access to care and increase costs that will be passed on to taxpayers. I ask that you implement Medicaid Expansion exactly as written, without burdensome regulations, barriers to coverage or wasteful bureaucracy. Thank you for your time!
